newsitem.title: INDIA: India's aluminium stocks gain on import hike.
newsitem.headline: India's aluminium stocks gain on import hike.

text.p: Shares of leading aluminium makers Hindalco and Nalco rose sharply on the Bombay bourse on Saturday, after India's federal budget proposed raising the import duty of aluminium.
Shares of Hindalco surged 59.25 rupees or 7.3 percent to 870.25. State-run Nalco's shares were trading 3.75 rupees, or 9.6 percent higher, at 42.75.
"The finance minister raised the import duty on aluminium to 20 percent from 10," said an aluminium analyst at a foreign brokerage.
"Hindalco and Nalco would be the main beneficiaries," he said, adding that both companies were likely to increase the prices of their products in the coming months.
He said both firms would also benefit from a reduction in corporate taxes, announced in the 1997/98 federal budget on Friday.
